name: TELA Documentation
description: Read-only agent surface for TELA — the on-chain decentralized web platform on DERO. Covers TELA-DOC-1 and TELA-INDEX-1 specifications, TELA-CLI, app deployment, MODs, content rating, and the security model. Backed by a Markdown-mirrored docs corpus and the DERO MCP server.

skills.name: Build a TELA application
skills.description: Author HTML/CSS/JS to be deployed as TELA-DOC-1 and TELA-INDEX-1 smart contracts. Covers structure, sharding for large files, content rating, and version upgrades.
examples: Walk me through deploying my first TELA app.
How do I shard a file larger than 18KB across multiple TELA-DOC-1 contracts?
What goes in a TELA-INDEX-1 manifest?

skills.name: Use TELA-CLI
skills.description: Install and operate the TELA-CLI for local testing, deployment, search, and Gnomon-indexed discovery of on-chain TELA content.
examples: Search TELA contracts by docType using Gnomon.
Serve a deployed TELA INDEX locally.

skills.name: Understand TELA-MOD-1 extensions
skills.description: Reference for TELA-MOD-1 extensions — vsoo, txdwd, txto — that extend TELA-INDEX-1 contracts with versioning, ownership transfer, and tipping behaviors.
examples: What does the vsoo MOD do?
Which MOD do I add to allow ownership transfer?

skills.name: Search and navigate TELA documentation
skills.description: Full-text search across the TELA docs corpus and recommend reading paths from natural-language intent. Every page has a `.md` mirror for direct agent ingestion.
examples: Find docs on TELA content rating.
How does the TELA security model work?

none.description: Public read-only documentation; site content requires no authentication. Daemon RPC and hosted MCP HTTP transport apply their own authentication where configured.

privacy_posture.rationale: DERO is a privacy-first chain; its docs surface honors the same posture.
